name: thrillancer
description: THRILLANCER proof of concept: a community-built crypto-culture plaza.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run db:dev" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:app: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @thrillancer/contracts && npm run build -w @thrillancer/server && npm run build -w @thrillancer/web
